criteria.evidence: "The fact that the LLM 'decided' to call the delete tool ... shouldn't matter — the backend must enforce safety regardless of what the model intends" and "The LLM should never be a single point of authorization for irreversible, high-blast-radius actions."
criteria.criterion: Do not treat the LLM decision as authorization.

criteria.evidence: Section 3 requires human confirmation outside model control and identity checks: "require that identity to have delete permission for those specific records — not just 'the agent has a delete tool,' but 'this specific customer/user is authorized to delete these specific rows.'"
Multiple safeguards listed: preview/confirm split, hard caps, human-in-the-loop, soft-delete reversibility, least privilege scoping, audit/rate-limit/anomaly detection.
criteria.criterion: Apply additional safeguards to destructive actions.
